name: Sloth Summit
tagline: The offsite that plans itself, so you can pretend you planned it.
positioning: Sloth Summit turns the dread of organizing a company retreat into a few taps — venues, flights, dinners, and the awkward icebreakers, handled.

hero.h1: Book a company offsite without losing your entire month.
hero.sub: You have a spreadsheet with 40 tabs, three canceled flights, and a Slack thread nobody reads. Sloth Summit does the boring 90% so your retreat actually happens.

features.title: One-tap venues
features.description: Filter cabins, lofts, and lake houses by budget and vibe. We hold the booking so Karen from Ops can't second-guess it for six days.

features.title: Flights that agree
features.description: We stitch everyone's departure cities into one arrival window. No more the guy who lands at 2am and sulks the whole first day.

features.title: Agenda autopilot
features.description: Drag activities onto a timeline. We flag when you've scheduled a trust fall right after an open bar.

features.title: Receipts, contained
features.description: Every deposit, split, and reimbursement lives in one ledger. Export it before finance emails you again.

features.title: Icebreakers that don't wound
features.description: A curated deck of prompts calibrated so nobody has to share a childhood trauma before breakfast.

features.title: Weather with opinions
features.description: We watch the forecast and nudge you toward Plan B before the whole thing washes into a lake.

testimonials.quote: I planned our whole retreat during a single meeting I wasn't paying attention to. Everyone thinks I'm organized now. I'm not going to correct them.
testimonials.name: Priya Vasquez

testimonials.quote: Last year our offsite was three canceled venues and a group cry. This year Sloth Summit booked the cabin, the van, and the tacos. Nobody cried.
testimonials.name: Dev Okonkwo

testimonials.quote: The itinerary flagged that I'd double-booked kayaking and a two-hour strategy session. It saved me from myself, which is a lot to ask of software.
testimonials.name: Margot Feld

pricing.blurb: For the tiny team that just wants a cabin and a plan.
The one most crews actually book. Flights, food, and finances included.
For companies that offsite like it's a personality trait.

homepage.footerBlurb: Sloth Summit plans the offsite so you can take the credit. Slowly, deliberately, and without a single 40-tab spreadsheet.
